text: Diary, 19 June. Still no payment. I sent invoice FR-0173 for 1,850 euros to the studio on 8 May with 30-day terms, so it was due on 7 June. Today I emailed Noor Rasmussen, the project manager who hired me, and she answered within minutes that she has nothing to do with payments and that Piotr Holm, the account manager, approves them. Piotr then replied that he cannot release anything until Noor signs off the delivery, which she says she did on 2 May. So each of them points at the other. This month has been rough anyway: my mum is in hospital after a bad fall, and I have been driving two hours each way to see her, so the unpaid money hurts more than usual. Tomorrow I will write one clear reminder to both of them.
